results.title: From Mentor to the Pacific: Katie Spotz prepares for her biggest challenge yet
results.description: Mentor’s Katie Spotz is getting ready for an adventure that’s hard to wrap your head around. This December, she plans to row solo across the Pacific Ocean from Lima, Peru, to Cairns, Australia.

results.title: 'Horror is international, and that includes Ulster-Scots': How the hamely tongue took a spooky turn for Halloween
results.description: This year, boils and ghouls seeking terror treats for Halloween will get a surprising new option – fright flicks in Ulster-Scots.
